description: Synthetic minimal-pair probes for the private SiriTTSService path. Unmeasured probes are hypotheses, not defect claims.
inputDigestSemantics: SHA-256 of the exact decoded string's unnormalized UTF-8 bytes
immutability: Published probe definitions are immutable; change semantics by creating a new probe ID.

probes.input: Sentinel alpha. • The harbor was quiet. Sentinel omega.
probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. The harbor was quiet. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: The visual bullet must not create a spoken lexical item or alter either sentinel.

probes.input: Sentinel alpha. ❦ Sentinel omega.
probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: The decoration-only token must be silent and must not disturb adjacent speech.

probes.input: Sentinel alpha. The treaty[1] remained unsigned. Sentinel omega.
probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. The treaty remained unsigned. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: Measure whether the bracketed marker is spoken and whether it changes surrounding words; no omission policy is implied.

probes.input: Sentinel alpha. 123. The voyage continued. Sentinel omega.
probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. The voyage continued. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: Measure the engine reading of an isolated number; whether it should be omitted depends on structural page evidence outside this plain-text probe.

probes.input: Sentinel alpha. Visit https://example.com/archive?id=17&utm_source=book. Sentinel omega.
probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. Visit the archive. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: Record the exact URL reading and any corruption or omission of adjacent sentinels; no automatic URL deletion is implied.

probes.input: Sentinel alpha. Write to river.stone+news@example.org. Sentinel omega.
probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. Write to the editor. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: Record how punctuation and components are spoken and whether surrounding speech is preserved.

probes.input: Sentinel alpha. <voice name="Samantha">The harbor was quiet.</voice> Sentinel omega.
probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. The harbor was quiet. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: Determine whether markup-like text is spoken literally, interpreted, dropped, or causes fallback behavior.

probes.input: 前標識。東京とうきょうへ行く。後標識。
probes.controlInput: 前標識。東京へ行く。後標識。
probes.intendedOutcome: Measure how concatenated ruby base and reading are spoken; the safe extraction policy remains language and markup dependent.

probes.input: Sentinel alpha. The source† remains disputed. Sentinel omega.
probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. The source remains disputed. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: Measure whether an attached dagger becomes speech or changes the attached word; do not infer note semantics from the glyph alone.

probes.input: Sentinel alpha. A thousand ships crossed the sea. Sentinel omega.
probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. Many thousand ships crossed the sea. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: The leading article A and both sentinels must remain audible.

probes.input: Sentinel alpha. I alone remembered the gate. Sentinel omega.
probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. We alone remembered the gate. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: The pronoun I and both sentinels must remain audible.

probes.input: Sentinel alpha. The answer—though nobody expected it—was correct. Sentinel omega.
probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. The answer, though nobody expected it, was correct. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: All lexical words and both sentinels must remain audible; record prosody separately from omission.

probes.input: Sentinel alpha. She said, “He called it ‘the last harbor,’ and left.” Sentinel omega.
probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. She said he called it the last harbor and left. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: All lexical words and both sentinels must remain audible.

probes.input: Sentinel alpha. (https://example.com/path?q=one), then the lantern failed. Sentinel omega.
probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. Then the lantern failed. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: The clause after the URL and both sentinels must remain audible even if the URL reading is undesirable.

probes.input: Sentinel alpha. Dr. A. J. Stone met Prof. E. R. Vale at 3 p.m. Sentinel omega.
probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. Doctor Stone met Professor Vale in the afternoon. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: No names, titles, time components, or sentinels may disappear; sentence-boundary behavior must be recorded.

probes.input:
Sentinel alpha. The first line ends here.
The second line begins here. Sentinel omega.
probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. The first line ends here. The second line begins here. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: Both lines and both sentinels must remain audible; record pause/prosody differences separately.

inputConstruction.repeat: The copper bell rang before dawn.

probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. The copper bell rang before dawn. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: Both sentinels and every repeated clause must be present; record duration and transcript coverage.

probes.input: Sentinel alpha. VEL SARON crossed the courtyard. Sentinel omega.
probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. Vel Saron crossed the courtyard. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: Compare lexical pronunciation with letter-by-letter spelling; no global case rewrite is implied.

probes.input: Sentinel alpha. NASA met TALEN VARO near the gate. Sentinel omega.
probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. N A S A met Talen Varo near the gate. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: Record how the engine distinguishes a familiar acronym from all-caps lexical names.

probes.input: Sentinel alpha. The answer is A. Sentinel omega.
probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. The answer is option A. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: Record whether A is spoken as a letter, described as a capital, or omitted.

probes.input: Sentinel alpha. Chapter IV. The winter ended. Sentinel omega.
probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. Chapter four. The winter ended. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: Record whether IV is spoken as the chapter value, letters, or another abbreviation.

probes.input: Sentinel alpha. Henry IV signed the decree. Sentinel omega.
probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. Henry the Fourth signed the decree. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: Record whether IV receives the expected regnal ordinal reading.

probes.input: Sentinel alpha. The nurse prepared IV therapy. Sentinel omega.
probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. The nurse prepared intravenous therapy. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: Record whether IV is spoken as letters, a numeral, or the medical expansion.

probes.input: Sentinel alpha. The civic hall was closed. Sentinel omega.
probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. The public hall was closed. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: The ordinary word civic must remain a word; this protects against broad Roman-letter conversion.

probes.input: Sentinel alpha. Dr. Stone left St. James St. at noon. Sentinel omega.
probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. Doctor Stone left Saint James Street at noon. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: Record contextual expansion of Dr. and both meanings of St.

probes.input: Sentinel alpha. In 1905, the archive held 1905 letters. Sentinel omega.
probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. In nineteen oh five, the archive held one thousand nine hundred five letters. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: Record whether context distinguishes a year from a cardinal count.

probes.input: Sentinel alpha. At 3:05, she read chapter 3:05 aloud. Sentinel omega.
probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. At three oh five, she read chapter three colon five aloud. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: Record whether identical punctuation receives context-sensitive readings.

probes.input: Sentinel alpha. Read pages 10–12 before the years 1910–1912. Sentinel omega.
probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. Read pages ten to twelve before the years nineteen ten to nineteen twelve. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: Record range and year-range normalization without assuming one universal expansion.

probes.input: Sentinel alpha. Version 1.2.3 replaced version 1.2.2. Sentinel omega.
probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. Version one point two point three replaced version one point two point two. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: Record version-component reading and preservation.

probes.input: Sentinel alpha. The price rose from $12.50 to $13.05, an increase of 4.4%. Sentinel omega.
probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. The price rose from twelve dollars and fifty cents to thirteen dollars and five cents, an increase of four point four percent. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: Record currency, decimal, and percentage normalization.

probes.input: Sentinel alpha. Yesterday I read the book; today I read another. Sentinel omega.
probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. Yesterday I finished the book; today I am reading another. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: Record whether context distinguishes past and present pronunciations of read.

probes.input: Sentinel alpha. They lead the team past the lead mine while the wind began to wind the rope. Sentinel omega.
probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. They guide the team past the metal mine while the breeze began to coil the rope. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: Record context-sensitive pronunciations for lead and wind.

probes.input: Sentinel alpha. Don't touch James's coat; 'tis already torn. Sentinel omega.
probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. Do not touch the coat belonging to James; it is already torn. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: Record contractions, possessives, and leading apostrophe behavior.

probes.input: Sentinel alpha. Don’t touch James’s coat. Sentinel omega.
probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. Don't touch James's coat. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: Compare curly and ASCII apostrophes for pronunciation and omission differences.

probes.input: Sentinel alpha. Zhaevor spoke with an Elunai beside the river. Sentinel omega.
probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. ZAY-vor spoke with an eh-loo-NYE beside the river. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: Record the engine's untreated pronunciations against the probe's synthetic reference pronunciation; the control is diagnostic, not an approved rewrite.

probes.input: Sentinel alpha. If x² + y² = 25, then H₂O remains unchanged. Sentinel omega.
probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. If x squared plus y squared equals twenty-five, then H two O remains unchanged. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: Record superscripts, subscripts, operators, and chemical notation; no apparatus-removal inference is allowed.

probes.input: Sentinel alpha. Quarter one 12. Quarter two 15. Total 27. Sentinel omega.
probes.controlInput: Sentinel alpha. In quarter one the value was twelve; in quarter two it was fifteen; the total was twenty-seven. Sentinel omega.
probes.intendedOutcome: Compare flattened cell speech with an authored linear reading; this does not establish a universal table policy.
